About Toll Group         At Toll, we do more than just logistics - we move the businesses that move the world. Our 16,000 team members can help solve any logistics, transport, or supply chain challenge - big or small. We have been supporting our customers for more than 130 years. Today, we support more than 20,000 customers worldwide with 500 sites in 27 markets, and a forwarding network spanning 150 countries. We are proudly part of Japan Post - www.tollgroup.com    Global Logistics provides sophisticated supply chain solutions, from end-to-end or part solutions, warehousing and distribution to dedicated transport solutions, across the globe and to some of the most remote corners of the world.      Retail, Consumer & Auto (RCA) provides specialised contract warehouse and distribution services to a range of industries across the globe including Consumer & Beverages, Specialty Retail, Auto and FMCG. We offer our customers an array of robust and flexible logistics and warehouse distribution solutions in the third-party logistics (3PL) market.          Operations Manager - PM Shift | Retail Fulfillment Centre, Prestons        Please note that this role is for the PM Shift- Hours 2PM - 10PM.         The Role       The Retail Fulfilment Centre, covering 32,000 square metres with state of the art automation technology. Your role will be to supervise and manage the daily operations and develop the 3rd party distribution centre of the Retail fulfilment Centre and associated distribution activities so that people and equipment are employed efficiently, and the warehousing and distribution activities are performed safely, accurately and in accordance with customer requirements. The Operations Manager directs the warehousing and distribution of the Retail Fulfilment Centre to ensure services and financial targets are consistently met.       This is a role where leadership, customer excellence and operational efficiency all come together, and you will need to drive high standards whilst ensuring the site is being run safely and efficiently.       As the Operations Manager, you will:   
 
 Plan and coordinate activities for the Retail fulfilment centre month-to-month to achieve results and standards.    
 
 
 Provide direct leadership to effectively deploy innovative practices and technologies leading to significant growth.    
 
 
 Maximise profitability through leading performance of an end-to-end work and operational processes.    
 
 
 Lead and drive weekly, monthly and quarterly plans for the operations function so that it has sufficient resources to achieve its agreed objectives and customer outcomes    
 
 
 Manage compliance, health & safety and people matters and overall standards.    
 
 
 Plan and implement operational and other necessary change initiatives at business site level to improve Business Unit profitability and productivity.    
 
 
 Be a influential leader driving team engagement by encouraging input, recognising performance and empowering team members to take responsibility for outcomes, building a strong team ethos that facilitates continuous improvement and the creation of a high performing team culture.    
 
     About You    
 
 Minimum 5 years in Logistics or warehouse management at a similar level    
 
 
 Proven Management experience in transport, logistics or fashion related industry.    
 
 
 Previous experience in managing a complex industrial environment    
 
 
 Exposure to 3PL Warehousing and familiarisation of automated warehousing - Vanderlande, Swisslog or Dematic preferred.    
 
 
 Be data driven with a strong data skilled background.    
 
 
 Strong Leadership Skills to manage and mentor the team.    
 
 
 Experience in managing warehouse and or logistics technology and driving operational improvements    
 
 
 Certificate or Diploma in Warehousing / business administration or related discipline    
 
 
 Ability to Drive the TOLL "Safety obsessed" strategy. Actively participate in the TOLL Incident & Injury free (IIF) program   
 
      What moves you?     
 At Toll, you can help play a vital role in delivering what matters. From food, fuel, medicine and rescue services, we keep businesses and communities thriving. Every day brings change. We see that as an opportunity. To be curious. To ask the right questions. And build meaningful connections. Because finding new ways to solve problems is what we do. With a bold vision to expand our global reach, our 16,000+ people bring a passion for progress. We collaborate in friendly, caring teams, supported by approachable leaders who give us the autonomy to quickly make decisions with impact. Learn and grow with industry-leading training, alongside talented experts. Feel empowered to take on diverse challenges and new responsibilities to move you, our customers, and our world further. 
 Are you excited about this role but are concerned you don't meet all the requirements? If you have similar skills and are willing to learn then we encourage you to apply anyway. We know that some people hesitate to apply for jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Toll, we value a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're interested in this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly then please talk to us - you may be just the right candidate for this or other roles we have coming up. 
 At Toll everyone is welcome including those of all ages, ethnicities, genders and abilities.

We are seeking an Associate Nurse Unit Manager (ANUM) to join Granada Ward, a specialised inpatient rehabilitation and palliative care unit, where you will make a meaningful difference in the lives of patients recovering from illness, surgery, and life-limiting conditions.

Our diverse caseload includes post-orthopaedic rehabilitation (hip, knee, and shoulder replacements), neurological recovery following stroke, reconditioning after cardiac and respiratory illness, post-cancer treatment care, pain management, and end-of-life support. This permanent part-time opportunity (56 hours per fortnight) offers the chance to further develop your leadership skills while working alongside an experienced and collaborative team. Our ward fosters a welcoming and supportive culture built on teamwork, continuous professional development, and a shared commitment to delivering excellence in rehabilitation and palliative care services.

Routinely monitors the results of diagnostic procedures and investigations and report abnormalities as required to the required caregiver.

Systematically evaluates and documents the outcomes of nursing-medical interventions and report significant anomalies promptly.

Benefits   Salary of $80000 - $82000 per annum plus superannuation.  Full-time permanent position with responsibility for an established specialist retail store.
